about_the_game:
Geo Fighters is an on rails, single player arcade style space shooter influenced by Geometry Wars. Single level infinite play mode getting progressively harder. Fight to put you name on the leaderboard and become the All time leader.

--Features--

14 unlockable ships.
2 unique sound tracks.
In game Steam leaderboard.
3 unique enemy types.
4 shoot modes.
Collectable power ups.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 or newer, Arch, Debian 12 "Bookworm" or newer.
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+ or Vulkan-capable, Nvidia and AMD GPUs, 1Gb Vram
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Gnome desktop environment running on top of X11 or Wayland windowing system, Nvidia official proprietary graphics driver, or AMD Mesa graphics driver. Other configuration and user environment as provided stock with the supported distribution (Kernel, Compositor, etc.) Notes: • Ubuntu 22.04: Wayland is supported with AMD graphics cards. • Ubuntu 24.04: Wayland is supported with AMD graphics cards and Nvidia graphics cards utilizing Nvidia proprietary graphics drivers 550 and above.

Other configuration and user environment as provided stock with the supported distribution (Kernel, Compositor, etc.) Notes: • Ubuntu 22.04: Wayland is supported with AMD graphics cards. • Ubuntu 24.04: Wayland is supported with AMD graphics cards and Nvidia graphics cards utilizing Nvidia proprietary graphics drivers 550 and above.
